blind.description: A stylized wooden bird perch or coat rack set into a wooden tub filled with smooth river stones. The tree consists of a curved, peeled-bark main trunk with three cut-off branch stumps extending out at different heights and angles, each ending in a flat cross-cut surface. The base is a small wooden stave bucket bound with two grey metal hoops, filled to the brim with dark grey stones supporting the trunk.
blind.from_above: A circular wooden tub containing dark grey stones, with light-coloured wooden branches fanning out predominantly along a single horizontal axis.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 4 feet tall (roughly two-thirds the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 1.5 to 2 feet wide at the branches and tub base.
